description_en: Modifies the configurations of an ApsaraDB RDS database proxy instance
description_zh: 该接口用于变更RDS数据库代理实例相关配置
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-proxy-instance --db-instance-id rm-t4n3a0000 --db-proxy-instance-type exclusive --db-proxy-instance-num 2 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBProxyInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database proxy instance. Valid values:
common: general-purpose database proxy
exclusive: dedicated database proxy (default)
parameters.help_zh:
数据库代理实例类型，取值：
common：通用型代理
exclusive：独享型代理（默认）
parameters.name: db_proxy_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of proxy instances. If this parameter is set to 0, the proxy service of this type is disabled for the instance. Valid values: 1 to 16.
More proxy instances can handle more requests. You can check the load of proxy instances based on monitoring data and then specify an appropriate number of proxy instances
parameters.help_zh:
设置代理实例数量。当取值为0的时候，表示这个实例关闭此种类型代理服务。取值：1~16。
更多的代理实例能处理更多的请求，您可以根据监控数据了解代理实例的负载，然后设置合理的代理实例数量
parameters.name: db_proxy_instance_num

parameters.help_en:
The effective period. Valid values:

Immediate: The modification takes effect immediately.
MaintainTime: The modification takes effect during the maintenance window. For more information, see ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime.
SpecificTime: The modification takes effect at a specified time.

Default value: MaintainTime
parameters.help_zh:
生效时间，取值：

Immediate：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在可运维时间段内生效，请参见ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime。
SpecificTime：指定时间生效。

默认值：MaintainTime
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en: The specified time for the modification to take effect. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). This parameter is required when EffectiveTime is set to SpecificTime
parameters.help_zh: 指定时间生效。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 EffectiveTime为SpecificTime时，该参数必传
parameters.name: effective_specific_time

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to obtain the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A deprecated parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter
parameters.name: db_proxy_engine_type

parameters.help_en: A deprecated parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter
parameters.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en:
The number of CPU cores for the node. Valid values: 1 to 16.
This parameter is required when DBProxyNodes is specified
fields.help_zh:
节点CPU核数，取值1~16。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: cpu_cores

fields.help_en:
The number of proxy nodes in the zone. Valid values: 1 to 2.
This parameter is required when DBProxyNodes is specified
fields.help_zh:
可用区中代理节点数量，取值1~2。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: node_counts

fields.help_en:
The zone ID of the node.
This parameter is required when DBProxyNodes is specified
fields.help_zh:
节点所在的可用区 ID。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of proxy nodes.
This parameter is required when the current proxy instance uses multi-active zone deployment
parameters.help_zh:
代理节点列表。
当前代理实例为多可用区部署时，该参数必传
parameters.name: db_proxy_nodes

fields.help_en:
The proxy endpoint ID. You can call DescribeDBProxyEndpoint to obtain the proxy endpoint ID.
This parameter is required when MigrateAZ is specified
fields.help_zh:
代理连接地址 ID。可以通过接口 DescribeDBProxyEndpoint 获取。
选择MigrateAZ时，该参数必选
fields.name: db_proxy_endpoint_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the destination vSwitch for the proxy instance migration.
This parameter is required when MigrateAZ is specified
fields.help_zh:
代理实例迁移对应的目标VSwitch ID。
选择MigrateAZ时，该参数必选
fields.name: dest_vswitch_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the destination VPC for the proxy instance migration.
This parameter is required when MigrateAZ is specified
fields.help_zh:
代理实例迁移对应的目标VPC ID。
选择MigrateAZ时，该参数必选
fields.name: dest_vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of active zones for proxy migration.
Currently, only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL proxy instances with cloud disks support active zone migration
parameters.help_zh:
迁移代理可用区列表。
当前仅支持RDS MySQL云盘版代理实例迁移可用区
parameters.name: migrate_az
